falsification_condition: The claim fails if any declared finite molecular state support lacks one unique least state; if an excited state lacks a positive successor or retained positive gap; if any pair is incomparable or contradictory; if the source-designated X state is not the unique least orderable NIST state for any registered species; if any of the 284 excited-state values does not lie above its species ground record; if any of the 306 exact measured energy inscriptions, uncertainty-status labels or source identities is omitted; or if a tied ground, negative gap, omitted row, unit-confounded row or tampered source is accepted.
